summary: Low-power wireless networks often need routes between two ordinary nodes, not just toward a central root. This document specifies AODV-RPL, which adapts the AODV route discovery approach to RPL so that peer-to-peer routes can be found for both symmetric and asymmetric links.

eli5.summary: Tiny sensors usually pass messages up to a boss. This lets one sensor ask around to find a direct path to another sensor, even if the path is better one way than the other.

questions: peer to peer routing in rpl
